final_netlist:
.subckt dut iin vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: IREF into NMOS diode
Mb   ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=4  L=1
* NMOS mirror -> PMOS diode (sets PMOS load gate)
Mn2  pb    ibias vss  vss nfet W=2 L=1
Mp2  pb    pb    vdd  vdd pfet W=4  L=1
* gain stage: NMOS common source with PMOS current-source load
Mp1  n1    pb    vdd  vdd pfet W=12.8 L=1
M1   n1    iin   vss  vss nfet W=6  L=0.5
* NMOS source-follower output buffer
Mf   vdd   n1    vout vss nfet W=15  L=0.3
Mn3  vout  ibias vss  vss nfet W=4  L=1
* shunt feedback network
Rf   vout  iin   145000
Cf   vout  iin   2e-14
.ends dut
